content: NestJS v12.0.1 released 2026-08-27 (ESM-first, Vitest default, new CLI) but is only ~2 weeks old at research time; v11.2.3 (released 2026-08-25) is the mature, CommonJS-compatible line with the full ecosystem (jwt, passport, swagger, terminus, config, typeorm) already on stable v11-compatible releases. Node.js 20 reached EOL April 2026; Node 24 is current Active LTS (EOL 2028). Recommend NestJS v11.2.x on Node 24.
